fields.description:
**Context**
When Emily selected an existing referrer on a sign-up during testing, she didn't see the expected default-country/province automation fire, and separately noticed Referral Type doesn't auto-populate based on the referrer chosen.

**Requirements**

* Verify/fix: selecting an existing referrer should auto-populate that referrer's default Country and Province on the sign-up (automation may already exist and not be firing correctly — confirm and fix).
* Verify/fix: selecting a referrer should auto-default the Referral Type field based on the referrer's typical/set referral type; user should still be able to override it manually.
* Confirm the existing automation where Referral Type drives an auto-calculated Payout Amount is still working (Kobi believes this exists but hasn't verified recently).
* Confirm: when Referral Type = Bet Credit, Payout Amount should default consistently with a "redeposit" value (per Taryn's notes) — validate the expected default value with Kobi/Emily during build.

**Constraints / Dependencies**
Kobi to confirm current automation state before build starts — unclear from the call whether this is a regression or was never built. Flag if it needs re-scoping once confirmed.

**Source**
Fathom — WagerTech <> Jumpr Weekly Sync, 09/23/2026 (https://fathom.video/calls/831090060) — Emily Vandenberg \~37:12–39:45, Kobi Kunasekaran \~38:00–39:45, Lina Ceniccola \~39:13. Also Taryn's notes, Sign-ups > "Select existing referrer, do we have automation to auto set referral type logic," "Bet credit chosen → payout amount should default to redeposit."
